Your first essay

A short sentence that previews the piece — appears under the title on the index page and on the reader.

01 January 2026 · 5 min · Tag one · Tag two

Replace this paragraph with your opening — the dropcap component takes a single text prop and renders the first letter as a display-typeface drop cap, with the rest of the paragraph wrapping around it.

The body of an essay can use markdown — paragraphs, headings, lists, blockquotes, inline code, and links. It can also use the four MDX components defined in src/components/: , , , and .

Section one

The headings on this page get auto-generated id slugs — match them in the toc: frontmatter array to drive the in-page table of contents.

Pull quotes use the Pullquote component when you want to attribute the quote, and PullquoteNoCite when the quote stands on its own.— a hint for the writer

Section two

You can drop a next to a paragraph for a handwritten margin note that appears in the right gutter on wide viewports and hides below 1200px.

To add another essay, drop a new .mdx file in src/content/articles/ with kind: Essay. It'll appear at /essays// automatically. Set kind: Study to land it at /studies// instead.
